objective: Test whether trained-CQ3 compensation can be preserved while replacing only greedily selected x8-output by 128-input cells with signed INT4, using all 64 calibration rows for selection and the previously unopened 32 layer-59 validation rows from four separate prompts for confirmation.

parent_finding.conclusion: Sparse higher-precision replacement has a real aggregate confirmation signal, but replacing complete output tiles discards useful trained-CQ3 compensation in unrelated input groups. Route at the x8-by-128 kernel-cell granularity instead.

scope.selection_reason: same frozen worst v44 down-projection layer; no layer reselection

int4_quantizer.representation: signed INT4 values in [-8, 7] with one FP16 scale per 128 weights
int4_quantizer.scale_initialization: group maximum absolute value divided by 7, with an exact-zero group mapped to scale zero
int4_quantizer.iteration: round and clamp integer codes, then replace scale by dot(weight, code) divided by dot(code, code)
int4_quantizer.code_packing: two signed nibbles per byte, low coordinate first

cell_selection.alternative: signed-INT4 quantization of the source BF16 weights for the same x8-by-128 cell
cell_selection.cell_delta: alternative cell output minus base cell output on the v44 trained-CQ3 gate/up activation
cell_selection.greedy_step: for each output tile independently, choose the unselected input group maximizing the exact current calibration residual-SSE reduction, then subtract that cell delta from the residual

canonical_layout.runtime_dispatch: one mode bit per x8-output by 128-input cell; mutually exclusive CQ3 or INT4 computation inside one down-projection pass

decision.if_pass: replicate the unchanged 16-cells-per-tile rule on a preregistered representative layer set before whole-model materialization
decision.if_fail: reject source-INT4 cell substitution and move to a trainable cell codebook or structured rotation without rate or threshold tuning on this confirmation split

claim_boundary: Frozen layer-59 calibration-to-disjoint-prompt confirmation representation pilot only. A pass cannot establish whole-model capability, perplexity, CUTE, MATH, code, MMLU, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
